title: No Tarium enrollment without project-specific owner authorization
summary: Do not enroll, remove or present a repository as an official Tarium member unless the owner explicitly authorized that specific membership operation on the named public repository. Project creation, naming, or public visibility does not grant enrollment.
statement: Do not enroll, remove or present a repository as an official Tarium member unless the owner explicitly authorized that specific membership operation on the named public repository. Project creation, naming, or public visibility does not grant enrollment.
rationale: Tarium's public constitution defines a specialized, independently selectable project requirement. Overlap with general Nomos guidance is intentionally preserved and auditable.

conditions: The task concerns an independently authorized public Tarium candidate or member project.
exceptions: This rule does not authorize Tarium membership changes, private-material disclosure, or unrelated repository operations.

preconditions: The user has separately authorized the relevant project task; Tarium membership remains a separately approved operation.
exclusions: No automatic cross-repository action, enrollment, or publication of nonpublic source data.

authority.source: Tarium public governance, selected as optional project guidance

provenance.reference: https://github.com/sguzman/tarium/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md; CONSTITUTION.md Article II; GOVERNANCE.md; SPEC-0120; processing/specimens/PROC-SPEC-0120.json
provenance.notes: Public governance-based abstraction; no private source conversation retained. Rule publication does not create project membership or apply it to a repository.
